neighbours.label: a plural or abstract noun that closes a noun phrase which the next words go on to specify ('a range of disciplines including', 'in our study'), as against the same nouns in simple statements
fire: By combining a range of fields such as chemistry and physics, the lab solved the puzzle.
The four towns in our survey managed their water in very different ways.
Drawing on many disciplines, including law and economics, the report makes its case.
The two hospitals in our study cut waiting times by different amounts.
Rural families cannot take for granted the roads and clinics that cities enjoy.
The course brings together several traditions, among them Greek and Roman thought.
The five schools in our sample reported very different results.
Using a variety of methods including interviews and surveys, the team mapped the city.
quiet: The chemistry lab was closed for cleaning on Monday.
The four towns held a joint fair in the summer.
Law and economics are popular subjects at the university.
The two hospitals share a parking lot near the river.
Rural families often keep chickens and grow vegetables.
The course meets on Tuesday evenings in the library.
The five schools closed early because of the snow.
The team walked across the city to the old market.
